value.zh: 强化问题与事件管理：规范 SR 处理、事件升级及紧急业务恢复流程，提升问题及时解决率和事故发生后 60 分钟内的业务恢复及时率，保障客户网络稳定运行。确保变更与操作可信：推动适用的变更操作 100% 纳入 IT 管道管理，落实 RFC/MOP 审批、高风险操作拦截、操作日志稽查及业务比对，重点关注 ORG 运营商的拦截分布及 TE 运营商的日志稽查合规性，确保操作合规、过程可追溯、结果可验证。推进主动风险治理：统筹 TOPN、网络整改、巡检、License、EOS 及第三方软件风险闭环，完善应急演练、预案拓扑和内控稽查，针对 ORG 运营商日志回传率未达标情况进行专项治理，防范已知风险引发现网重大业务中断与事故。
value.en: Standardize SR handling, incident escalation and emergency recovery; improve timely resolution and service recovery within 60 minutes. Ensure all applicable changes follow IT pipeline governance, RFC/MOP approval, high-risk operation interception, log audits and business verification, with a focus on ORG operator interception distribution and TE operator log audit compliance. Close TOPN, remediation, inspection, License, EOS and third-party software risks, strengthen emergency drills, contingency plans, topology and internal audits, and address the log transmission rate issue for ORG to prevent major service interruptions.
